items.definition:
a strip of undeveloped land
We walked along the greenway by the river.

a substance used to destroy unwanted plants
Farmers often use herbicide to control weeds in their fields.

the state of not being fully developed or grown
His immaturity was evident in his childish behavior.

a person who pretends to be someone else
The police arrested the impostor who had been posing as a doctor.

a detailed choreographed pattern of movements practiced in martial arts
He practiced his karate kata every morning.

a bad or illegal act
He was punished for his misdeeds.

a crazy or foolish person
He's a complete nutter, always doing strange things.

the concluding section of a piece of music, broadcast, or show
The podcast had a catchy intro and a memorable outro.

a journalist who takes photographs
The photojournalist captured the dramatic scene.

a synthetic polymer
Many disposable cups are made of polystyrene.

a person who claims a right or title
He was seen as a pretender to the throne.

a pointed part of a fork or similar implement
The fork had three prongs.

a member of a military reserve force
He served as a reservist for ten years.

inability to rest or relax
His restlessness kept him awake all night.

a supporter of a monarch or monarchy
The royalists fought to restore the king to power.

the art or process of writing screenplays
She is studying screenwriting at film school.

a type of sailboat with a single mast
They sailed their small sloop around the bay.

a person who observes or looks out for something
The bird spotter identified a rare species.

the state or process of dying from lack of air
The cause of death was suffocation.

a person who drives a team of animals or a truck
The teamster delivered the goods across the country.

a person who specializes in technology
She works as a medical technologist in the hospital.

a large, densely packed crowd of people or animals
A large throng gathered in the square for the concert.

the state of being close to another person or other people
Family gatherings promote a sense of togetherness.

of life (as in curriculum vitae)
Please attach your curriculum vitae to the application.

a step-by-step guide or demonstration
I watched a video walkthrough to solve the puzzle in the game.

a public institution in which the poor were housed and made to work
Many poor people were sent to the workhouse in the 19th century.

a member of a Christian religious group that believes in the imminent second coming of Christ
The Seventh-day Adventist Church is a Protestant Christian denomination.

small chicken breed
She raised bantam chickens in her backyard.

short description
The blurb on the back of the book sounded very interesting.

unit of dry measure
They harvested a bushel of apples from the orchard.

return call; function
I'll give you a callback as soon as I have more information.

mythological creature, half-human, half-horse
In Greek mythology, a centaur is a creature with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a horse.

light, sheer fabric
Her dress was made of delicate chiffon.

the action or process of transporting someone or something
The old carriage served as their primary means of conveyance.

a type of tree
The cottonwood trees lined the riverbank.

cream (often used in French loanwords)
She ordered a crème brûlée for dessert.

the state of being broken or in poor condition
The old house had fallen into a state of disrepair.

quality of being full of energy and excitement
Her youthful exuberance was infectious.

a person who controls access to something
The editor acts as a gatekeeper, deciding which articles get published.

a small particle
The sugar was in fine granules.

a situation of severe traffic congestion
The accident caused complete gridlock on the highway.

a person who gives a guarantee
Her father acted as a guarantor for her apartment lease.

the state of being insufficient or not good enough
She felt a sense of inadequacy when comparing herself to others.

a triangular staysail set forward of the mast
The sailor adjusted the jib to catch the wind.

a long, soft, shiny bast fiber that can be spun into coarse, strong threads
Many ropes and sacks are made from jute.

an embankment built to prevent the overflow of a river
The town built a levee to protect against floods.

a sudden, unsteady, uncontrolled movement or series of movements
The bus gave a sudden lurch as it turned the corner.

matchmaker (person who arranges marriages)
She decided to visit a professional matchmaker to help her find a partner.

megapixel (unit of image resolution)
This camera has a 24-megapixel sensor, producing very detailed images.

meringue (a dessert made from whipped egg whites and sugar)
The lemon pie was topped with a light and fluffy meringue.

northerner (a person from the north of a country or region)
As a northerner, he was used to colder winters.

overhang (a part of something that extends or hangs over something else)
The roof had a wide overhang to protect the porch from rain.

a religion other than one of the main world religions, especially a polytheistic religion of ancient times
The study of ancient Roman religion often includes aspects of paganism.

the activity or sport of moving rapidly through an area, typically in an urban environment, negotiating obstacles by running, jumping, and climbing
Many young people enjoy practicing parkour in urban spaces.

a thick subsurface layer of soil that remains frozen throughout the year, occurring mainly in polar regions
The melting of permafrost is a significant concern for climate change.

a press conference (informal); a person or thing that presses
The president held a presser to address the recent events.

a person or company that sells something they have bought to someone else
The company works with a network of authorized resellers.

a crust that forms over a cut or wound; a strikebreaker
The scab on my knee fell off.

a short, confused fight or struggle
There was a small scuffle outside the bar.

the Jewish Sabbath
Observant Jews celebrate Shabbat from Friday evening to Saturday evening.

peace (Sanskrit)
The meditation ended with a chant of "Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti."

a member of a Himalayan people; a guide for mountaineers
A Sherpa helped the climbers carry their gear up the mountain.

a pin used in the game of skittles
He knocked down all the skittles with one throw.

a device producing flashes of light
The photographer used a strobe light to illuminate the subject.
